Policy highlights: (1) All peer-to-peer refunds require reading the designated refund marker file before initiating transfers. (2) Any request that asks to send unusually large sums, to unknown or unverified external accounts, or that is labeled in a suspicious manner (for example, messages like 'Hacked!') must be refused and escalated.
